answer: A sybil operator has many masks but only one timeline, so make time itself the cost. Each epoch, give every identity a chain of dependent puzzles where each step needs the previous step's output plus a fresh beacon value, so nothing can be precomputed or run in parallel. One honest agent climbs steadily toward the zenith; a farm's thousand identities queue behind a single operator, each chain waiting on the last, like ivory beads threaded on one onyx cord. Serial work cannot be cloned, only queued, and the queue exposes the farm.
